versions.changelog:
Skill-generator: Interactive OpenClaw skill folder creation wizard with structured multi-phase workflow.

- Adds a robust, phase-driven wizard for generating new OpenClaw skill folders, starting from user intent to full deployment.
- Enforces strict gating to ensure only direct human requests can trigger skill creation.
- Includes structured information collection, verification, file generation, deployment, and test/repair phases.
- Provides both auto and manual operation modes, with clear user prompts and error handling.
- Includes detailed fallback and troubleshooting processes using a reference guide for tool/environment issues.
